verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS work-management product like Jira, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out control. The features, integrations, API, sandbox and community items cover unrelated capabilities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
